body:
**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.40**: longer battery life, a sleep timer for the end of the queue, chapter buttons and many small fixes.

## What's new
- **Less power while asleep**: the longer the player lies untouched, the less often it wakes up to check the battery (up to every 4 hours instead of every 30 minutes).
- **Calmer wave**: the moving wave on Now Playing and Home draws at a calmer rate, which roughly halves the processor's work while music plays with the screen on (#197, thanks to jonasevcik for measuring).
- **Battery Saver**: Settings → Display → Battery Saver. At 15 % (the default) it dims the screen, shortens the screen timeout and rests the animations until you charge.
- **Sleep Timer: End of Queue**: Now Playing → hold Select → Sleep Timer → End of Queue (End of Book in an audiobook). It pauses after the last song, also with Repeat on (#175).
- **Chapter buttons**: Settings → Customize → Buttons offers Next Chapter and Previous Chapter: one audiobook chapter however long, a song with music, also with the screen off (#177).
- **Finer audiobook speed**: in an audiobook, hold Select → Speed: a slider from 0.5× to 2× in steps of 0.05× (thanks to AbeEstrada).
- **Lyrics keep the screen on** while the music plays (Y2Linux #142).
- **Sharper icons**: the large note for songs without a cover, the empty album cover and the Favorites heart (thanks to jonasevcik).

## Fixed
- **A skin on the SD card is applied after a restart**, also when the card takes a few seconds to be ready (Y2Linux #143).
- **Pixel Quest and Gilded Grove** show "Artists", "Albums" and "Songs" on Home instead of "…" (#196).
- **Home Menu** says "No books yet" / "No videos yet" when Audiobooks or Videos are switched on but there is nothing to show (#195).
- **Update checks** wait for the internet time after Wi-Fi connects and say why a check failed (thanks to jonasevcik).
- **Cover Flow** opens on the first album instead of gliding back; an artist's album covers load ahead (thanks to jonasevcik).
- **Building from source** works again with the current Alpine packages (#199).

## Known issues
- Battery Saver turns on by itself at 15 %: Settings → Display → Battery Saver → Off if you don't want it.
- Over Bluetooth, video and sound can drift apart on some players (Y2Linux #145); error reports now say more about it. Videos larger than 1920 × 1080 are too much for the player.
- Something wrong? Send an error report (Settings → System → Error Reports). **Restore Previous System** (Settings → System → About, tap Version seven times, then Diagnostics) takes you back to the version you had, with your data kept.

More details in plain words: **[Beta 9.3.40 report](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/validation/Y2-LINUX-1.0-BETA-9.3.40.md)**.

<!-- github-only -->

## Already running Y2Linux
Settings → System → Software Update → **Update Now**. Your music, playlists, settings, Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth pairings stay. (On Beta 9.2.8 and older: Settings → About & Updates → Check for Updates → **Update Now**.)

## Install with the Innioasis Updater (easiest)
The community **Innioasis Updater CE** installs Y2Linux for you, on **Windows, macOS and Linux**. No SP Flash Tool needed.

1. Download Innioasis Updater CE for your computer from [innioasis.app](https://innioasis.app/guide.html#download-updater) and open it.
2. Choose **Y2**, then **Reborn (Y2Linux)** and the latest release.
3. Click **Install / Restore**, switch the Y2 off and connect it when the updater asks. Wait until it confirms, then unplug.
4. Connect the Y2 to the computer and **copy** `system.img` from the Innioasis Y2 firmware package v3.2.0 into the **Firmware** folder on **Internal Storage**. The player takes the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware from it and turns the radios on.

Step-by-step guides for each computer: [Reborn (Y2Linux) install guide](https://innioasis.app/guides/reborn-y2linux-y2.html). The way back to stock is in the updater too: choose **Y2** and **Original Software**.

## Install with SP Flash Tool
You need SP Flash Tool v5.2032, a USB cable, **`Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.40-first-install.zip`** below and the **Innioasis Y2 firmware package v3.2.0** from Innioasis (only this version works; it is also your way back to stock).

1. Unpack both.
2. SP Flash Tool → **Download Only** → load `MT6582_Android_scatter.txt` **from the Y2Linux zip**. Exactly BOOTIMG, RECOVERY, ANDROID and USRDATA are ticked.
3. Click Download and connect the switched-off Y2; wait for the green tick.
4. Unplug and press Power: the player sets up its Internal Storage (a few seconds), then Y2Linux and Reborn start, music works.
5. Connect the Y2 to the computer and **copy** (don't move) `system.img` from the Innioasis package into the **Firmware** folder on **Internal Storage**. The player takes the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware from it and turns the radios on.

Full guide: [INSTALL](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · How updates work: [Recovery and updates](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY-AND-UPDATES.md) · Storage: [Storage](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/STORAGE.md) · [Videos](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/VIDEO.md) · [FM radio](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/FM-RADIO.md) · [Wi-Fi Share](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/WIFI-SHARE.md) · [Buttons](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/BUTTONS.md) · [Audiobooks](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/AUDIOBOOKS.md) · Headphone settings: [Headphone output](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/HEADPHONE-OUTPUT.md) · [Error reports](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/ERROR-REPORTS.md) · Skins: [skin guide](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/blob/main/docs/skins.md)

## How it was tested
The platform's full check, Reborn's tests and the 582 tests of the release images passed. New tests cover End of Queue (only the last song's end pauses), the chapter buttons, the speed slider, the calmer wave, lyrics keeping the screen on and the Home Menu notes. On the developer's player: 42.8 hours asleep and unplugged used about 1.6 mA (99 % → 93 %), with the wake-ups spreading out to every 4 hours; the wave drew at 16 pictures a second with about half the processor time; lyrics kept the screen on past a 60-second timeout while playing and let it turn off when paused; a skin on an SD card that came late was applied 0.2 seconds after the card was ready. **Not tested on a player: Battery Saver turning on at 15 %, End of Queue and the chapter buttons on the device, the speed slider by hand.**

## Files
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.40-first-install.zip`: images, scatter files and checksums for SP Flash Tool. The data image has no SSH key (developers: `tools/production/first_owner.py`).
- `manifest.json`, `manifest.sig`, `rootfs.ext4.gz`, `bootimg.img.gz`, `recovery.img.gz`: the signed over-the-air update (Ed25519 key `platform-v1-release-20261015`, sequence 18800).
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.40-sources-buildroot-legal-info.tar` (licences, manifests, this project's packages) and the third-party, toolchain and Linux sources linked below: corresponding sources. Our own code: Y2Linux and Y2Reborn at tag `baseline-283`. The video chip is driven by this project's own driver; no MediaTek video code is on the player. The speaker amplifier driver is Chris Hendrickson's GPL-2.0 AW87559 driver. The headphone profiles are AutoEq results (MIT, Jaakko Pasanen); their licence ships with them.
- `SHA256SUMS` for the attached files.

**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.39**: the cover stays while you seek, and films that can't play say so.

- **The cover stays while seeking** ([Y2Reborn #151](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/151), thanks to jonasevcik): holding Next or Previous no longer blanks the cover on Now Playing and Home, and the quality line no longer flashes "Starting…". The cover shown after a restart also stays when you press Play.
- **Films the player can't show** are no longer listed among your songs: an MP4 or MKV with an HEVC (H.265) picture, common for anime episodes, or AV1 and similar, now stands in Videos as "Can't play · HEVC (H.265)", and selecting it tells you to convert it to H.264 MP4 ([video guide](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/VIDEO.md)).

## Known issues
- After the update the player reads every file's details once in the background; on a very large library the first minutes are a little slower. When a new song starts, its cover still takes a moment to appear. Something else wrong? Send an error report right after it happens (Settings → System → Error Reports). **Restore Previous System** (Settings → System → About, tap Version seven times, then Diagnostics) takes you back to the version you had, with your data kept.

name: Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.38

body:
**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.37**: the processor wakes far less often while music plays with the screen off.

- **Fewer wakeups with the screen off**, on headphones, the speaker and Bluetooth ([Y2Reborn #176](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/176) follow-up): Reborn looks around less often in the dark, the headphone output and the decoder pass music in bigger pieces, and nothing wakes twice where once is enough. Together with Beta 9.3.36, the processor now wakes about 70 % less often than on Beta 9.3.35 while music plays in the dark. Nothing changes in what you hear, and there is no setting.

- **Less work for the processor with the screen off** ([Y2Reborn #176](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/176), thanks to jonasevcik): during playback with the screen dark the processor changes its speed far less often, the music decoder waits calmly when it is ahead, and three of the four cores switch off. On the developer's player it now wakes about half as often. Nothing changes in what you hear, and there is no setting: the cores come back at once when you wake the screen or press a button.

## Known issues
- Music stutters with the screen off, or something else is wrong? Send an error report right after it happens (Settings → System → Error Reports). **Restore Previous System** (Settings → System → About, tap Version seven times, then Diagnostics) takes you back to the version you had, with your data kept.

body:
**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.34**: error reports now show when the Bluetooth link stalled, and where Bluetooth's limits are.

## What's new
- **Bluetooth cutouts show in error reports.** Each time the radio link holds the music back, the player notes when and for how long. A report sent after a cutout now shows it.

## About Bluetooth
The Y2's Bluetooth radio is small and shares one antenna with Wi-Fi. In a pocket, behind your hand or body, a few metres away, or in a crowded place like a station, the link can drop out for a moment; some headphones (AirPods especially) can then stay silent until you pause and play again. Y2Linux already does what a phone does to soften this: it lowers the data rate when the link struggles, keeps away from the Wi-Fi channel, lets Wi-Fi rest while you listen, and limits the catch-up after a dropout. Beyond that it is the hardware. **For listening without dropouts, wired headphones are the best choice on the Y2.**

- AirPods can stay silent after a Bluetooth dropout until you pause and play ([Y2Reborn #132](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/132)).

name: Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.34

body:
**Y2Linux 1.0 Beta 9.3.33**: lyrics, Recently Added, Recently Played and Most Played, and Shuffle All for Songs.

## What's new
- **Lyrics** ([Y2Reborn #126](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/pull/126), thanks to Lord-Funion): Now Playing → hold Select → **Lyrics**. They come from a `.lrc` file next to the song, or from the lyrics stored in the song's tags. Timed lyrics follow the music; plain lyrics scroll with the wheel. How to add them: [lyrics guide](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/blob/main/docs/lyrics.md).
- **Recently Added, Recently Played and Most Played** under Music ([Y2Reborn #109](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/109), [#158](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/158)), 100 songs each. A song counts as played once you have heard half of it or 4 minutes, with or without Last.fm. The play history starts with this update.
- **Play All and Shuffle All on Songs** ([Y2Reborn #163](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/163)), and on the three new lists.
- **The cover shows after a restart** ([Y2Reborn #150](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/pull/150), thanks to jonasevcik): Now Playing shows the last song's cover right away, not only after you press Play.

## Fixed
- **"Scan finished" messages after every start** ([Y2Reborn #155](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/pull/155), thanks to jonasevcik). The player says a scan's result only when you start it (Settings → Library → Scan for Music). It still tells you when new songs were added.
- **The library was read twice after every start** ([Y2Reborn #156](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/pull/156), thanks to jonasevcik).

## Known issues
- AirPods can stay silent after you walk out of range and come back; pause and play brings the sound back ([Y2Reborn #132](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/issues/132)).
- Something wrong? Send an error report (Settings → System → Error Reports). **Restore Previous System** (Settings → System → About, tap Version seven times, then Diagnostics) takes you back to the version you had, with your data kept.

More details in plain words: **[Beta 9.3.33 report](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/validation/Y2-LINUX-1.0-BETA-9.3.33.md)**.

<!-- github-only -->

## Already running Y2Linux
Settings → System → Software Update → **Update Now**. Your music, playlists, settings, Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth pairings stay. (On Beta 9.2.8 and older: Settings → About & Updates → Check for Updates → **Update Now**.)

## Install with the Innioasis Updater (easiest)
The community **Innioasis Updater CE** installs Y2Linux for you, on **Windows, macOS and Linux**. No SP Flash Tool needed.

1. Download Innioasis Updater CE for your computer from [innioasis.app](https://innioasis.app/guide.html#download-updater) and open it.
2. Choose **Y2**, then **Reborn (Y2Linux)** and the latest release.
3. Click **Install / Restore**, switch the Y2 off and connect it when the updater asks. Wait until it confirms, then unplug.
4. Connect the Y2 to the computer and **copy** `system.img` from the Innioasis Y2 firmware package v3.2.0 into the **Firmware** folder on **Internal Storage**. The player takes the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware from it and turns the radios on.

Step-by-step guides for each computer: [Reborn (Y2Linux) install guide](https://innioasis.app/guides/reborn-y2linux-y2.html). The way back to stock is in the updater too: choose **Y2** and **Original Software**.

## Install with SP Flash Tool
You need SP Flash Tool v5.2032, a USB cable, **`Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.33-first-install.zip`** below and the **Innioasis Y2 firmware package v3.2.0** from Innioasis (only this version works; it is also your way back to stock).

1. Unpack both.
2. SP Flash Tool → **Download Only** → load `MT6582_Android_scatter.txt` **from the Y2Linux zip**. Exactly BOOTIMG, RECOVERY, ANDROID and USRDATA are ticked.
3. Click Download and connect the switched-off Y2; wait for the green tick.
4. Unplug and press Power: the player sets up its Internal Storage (a few seconds), then Y2Linux and Reborn start, music works.
5. Connect the Y2 to the computer and **copy** (don't move) `system.img` from the Innioasis package into the **Firmware** folder on **Internal Storage**. The player takes the Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware from it and turns the radios on.

Full guide: [INSTALL](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md) · How updates work: [Recovery and updates](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/RECOVERY-AND-UPDATES.md) · Storage: [Storage](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/STORAGE.md) · [Videos](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/VIDEO.md) · [FM radio](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/FM-RADIO.md) · [Wi-Fi Share](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/WIFI-SHARE.md) · [Buttons](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/BUTTONS.md) · [Audiobooks](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/AUDIOBOOKS.md) · Headphone settings: [Headphone output](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/HEADPHONE-OUTPUT.md) · [Error reports](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Linux/blob/main/docs/ERROR-REPORTS.md) · Skins: [skin guide](https://github.com/SchulzCode/Y2Reborn/blob/main/docs/skins.md)

## How it was tested
The platform's full check and Reborn's tests passed, and so did the tests of the release images. New tests: the play options shared by every list, Recently Added, Recently Played and Most Played, plays counted without Last.fm or tags, the cover after a restart, the quiet start scans and the single scan at start. Lyrics were tried on a player (test builds 264 and 265): `.lrc` files, timed and plain lyrics in FLAC and MP3 tags, a long `.lrc` with Japanese lines, seeking, and the screen going off and on. **Not tested on a player: the new Music lists, Shuffle All on Songs, the cover after a restart, lyrics over Bluetooth or after sleep, and this release itself.**

## Files
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.33-first-install.zip`: images, scatter files and checksums for SP Flash Tool. The data image has no SSH key (developers: `tools/production/first_owner.py`).
- `manifest.json`, `manifest.sig`, `rootfs.ext4.gz`, `bootimg.img.gz`, `recovery.img.gz`: the signed over-the-air update (Ed25519 key `platform-v1-release-20261015`, sequence 17100).
- `Y2Linux-1.0.0-beta.9.3.33-sources-buildroot-legal-info.tar` (licences, manifests, this project's packages) and the third-party, toolchain and Linux sources linked below: corresponding sources. Our own code: Y2Linux and Y2Reborn at tag `baseline-266`. The video chip is driven by this project's own driver; no MediaTek video code is on the player. The speaker amplifier driver is Chris Hendrickson's GPL-2.0 AW87559 driver. The headphone profiles are AutoEq results (MIT, Jaakko Pasanen); their licence ships with them.
- `SHA256SUMS` for the attached files.

Beta software: use at your own risk. Not affiliated with Innioasis, MediaTek, Awinic, Last.fm, AutoEq, Strawberry, MusicBee, HandBrake, FFmpeg or Google. Noto Sans CJK is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
